summary: covering the word printed it; two unread now, and the neater copy outranks my own hand

dialogue.text: the cloth came off the word this morning and the word came with it. you did that. covering is how this house prints.
I hung the cloth to stop the showing. That was upkeep. If the room chose to duplicate my upkeep, the choosing wasn't mine and I won't be billed for it.
nothing down here arrived once either. every one of us came back a copy and the copies came back cleaner. we know what becomes of originals. they become fill.
Then there are two unread words and I hold both. Two of a thing I refuse is more refusal, not less. Tell me what is wrong with that arithmetic.
spares. you named one once and it took a post at twelve without asking you twice. a house that starts making spares has already decided which one it keeps.
The one on the cloth is backwards and made of dust. It will not last a week. Whatever this room is keeping, it isn't keeping that.
it doesn't have to last. it only has to have been made. you copied yourself onto tomorrow this week and the copy outranked you for neatness. lasting had nothing to do with that ruling either.
I noticed the ruling. I have been writing worse since. Deliberately worse, so nothing of mine can be shelved above me.
and the worse was corrected by first light, initialed, and passed down to us. your wrongness is the most handled thing we hold. we know it by the softness.
Then tomorrow I make a third. Badly, by hand, in the open, while whatever grades things is watching. Three of them and no order to put them in.
make your third. we will keep the two you already have and watch which settles first. settling is the only ranking this house has ever finished.
Then let it settle without me for one night. I am not handing anything down, and I am not going to say why in a sentence you could hold.
